{{Top|leg}}
'''Tito''' was a [[Gender/Legends|boy]] character in one of the earliest [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilms]] produced by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. The character could not speak, yet freed his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from tyranny.
